data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 offers a causal diagnosis (stale/non-canonical artifact version) for the flagged failures, but it provides zero evidence that such a version mismatch actually occurred. The claim that the harness evaluated against a stale instance is asserted as fact without any artifact hash comparison, version-difference citation, or harness-log evidence. Under an audit standard (§11.3), asserting a specific infrastructural root cause without corroborating evidence is an un substantiated assertion: the explanation is internally coherent but unfalsifiable in its presented form, since no reader can verify whether the version pinning was genuinely inconsistent or whether SRC_001 is retroactively inventing a plausible-sounding excuse for the flags.
